payload.title: Live Emotion run on Jev and results (L0-L4)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Run the staged live experiment on Jev and publish the results.

## Scope

L0 labeler comments (OpenAI gpt-6-luna, cap ~500 calls); L1 round 1 all arms -> STOP 1; L2 rounds 2-3 -> STOP 2; L3 final slice for 4 arms after the owner's go; L4 optional D on the final slice; results/publish. New ledger per stage; each stage runs with `--max-new-requests` equal to its printed bound.

## Cost cap

**Hard cumulative cap $10** across all stages (upper bound ~13,000 Jev requests, worst case ~$8; labeler < $0.50). Nothing live before S8 is closed.

## Definition of done

All required stages run within their bounds, results published, issues closed with evidence.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
